verdict.rationale: Vendor docs claim Fin resolves 76% of customer queries on average and handles multi-step queries end to end. Procedures let it carry business logic and third-party actions from start to finish. A community report that Fin charges $1 per successful session points to resolution-based measurement rather than deflection counting. Missing for 10: documented definition of what counts as a resolution versus a deflection or bounce, analytics evidence showing how resolution rate is reported, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the 76% figure.
